Questions? We have answers.

What ages is BrightBreak Play made for?

The activities are designed as a starting point for children ages 4–7, with an adult helping adapt them to each child's abilities and interests.

Is this a physical product?

No. It's a downloadable digital PDF for printing at home. Nothing is shipped.

Do I need a printer?

Printing is convenient, but an adult can read each mission and recreate it on plain paper.

Will I need special craft supplies?

No. A pencil, crayons, and everyday safe objects are enough for most missions.

How long does each activity take?

About ten minutes is a suggested starting point. Keep going—or stop—according to your child's interest.

Can I print an activity again?

Yes, for personal use within your own household. Public sharing, resale, and redistribution are not permitted.

Does this treat attention difficulties or improve learning scores?

No. BrightBreak Play is a recreational family activity kit and makes no medical, therapeutic, or academic performance claims.

How are payments and refunds handled?

Payments and delivery are not connected on this demonstration page. The live store must publish accurate payment and refund terms before taking orders.
